baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence yulhiduna fi ayatina, la yakhfawna alayna, and basir.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ilhad is modeled as a lateral turn away from a presented marker. The denial of concealment and the closing claim of penetrating sight make that turn an attempted movement into a blind spot that does not exist.

activation_trace.role: A move toward an edge or side supplies the deviation's directional geometry.
An outwardly legible marker supplies the visible object whose course is being bent.
Covering or remaining unseen names the evasion explicitly denied by the construction.
Penetrating awareness closes the mechanism by making deeds inwardly known as well as externally observable.

changed_reading.before: The ayah generally condemns people who distort signs and warns that God knows.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages deviation as a directional attempt to move explicit signs toward a side channel, while declaring that no such movement creates an epistemic blind spot.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive yulqa fi al-nar is set against the active ya'ti aminan on the Day of Rising.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question contrasts two trajectories, not merely two static conditions: forced disposal into fire and self-arrival in settled security. The comparative and resurrection frame make present choice terminate in a mode of arrival.

activation_trace.role: Throwing or casting supplies a forced transfer in which the person is grammatically acted upon.
The burning destination gives the passive transfer its punitive terminus.
Selection between alternatives turns the rhetorical comparison into a present practical choice.
Coming and reaching supply the opposed trajectory of active arrival.
Settled freedom from expected harm defines the quality of that arrival.
The rising of creation fixes both trajectories at the final public event.

changed_reading.before: The ayah compares a punished person with a saved person.
changed_reading.after: It compares two enacted trajectories: one is handled as an object and cast to a destination, while the other reaches the final assembly in a condition of settled security.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: I'malu ma shi'tum is enclosed by two occurrences of amal and the final bima ta'maluna basir.
baseline_models.mechanism: The apparent latitude of willing is bracketed by intentional work and comprehensive sight. Choice is real enough to produce deeds, but never supplies anonymity or escape from their visibility.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action frames both the imperative and the final assessment, turning freedom into authored conduct.
Volition supplies the latitude under which the conduct is selected.
Discerning knowledge removes any inference that latitude entails unobserved action.

changed_reading.before: Do whatever you wish is an unrestricted permission or a generic threat.
changed_reading.after: It is an exposure test: willing remains operative, each choice becomes intentional work, and the enclosing sight makes that work inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus imperative returns the opponents' own challenge in 41:5. The intervening testimony scene makes work bodily disclosive, and 41:46 makes its consequence return to the actor; the command therefore hands their boast back as self-authored evidence.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work is the repeated focus hinge between the taunting command and divine inspection.
The same purposeful-action branch supplies the opponents' reciprocal challenge, which the focus command later echoes.
Attended witnessing converts past conduct into evidence presented against its doers.
Attempted covering identifies the failed strategy that the focus denial of hiddenness answers.
Purposeful action is explicitly assigned a consequence rather than left as transient behavior.
The actor's own self is the destination of that consequence, making the work reflexive.

structural_cues: 41:5 first voices 'work' as an oppositional challenge.
41:20-23 turn deeds into bodily testimony and expose the assumption that much action escaped knowledge.
41:46 assigns good or evil action for or against the actor's own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated work formula, failed covering, testimony, and reflexive consequence; I infer that 41:40 deliberately returns the earlier boast as an evidentiary command. A live alternative is that the repetition is thematic reinforcement without a direct rhetorical callback.

changed_reading.before: The imperative grants temporary latitude under surveillance.
changed_reading.after: The imperative is also a returned quotation-like challenge: keep producing the very work that bodies will disclose and that will come back for or against the worker.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, signs are articulated clearly while resistant hearers build a layered reception system of coverings, ear-weight, barrier, refusal, noise, blindness, and distance. Ilhad in the focus is thereby sharpened from a private wrong view into active rerouting and sabotage of how signs reach hearers.

activation_trace.role: A verbal turn or objection anchors ilhad in adversarial handling of communicated signs.
The sign remains an outward marker, so the failure lies in its handling rather than its absence.
Articulation into distinct parts and meanings supplies a deliberately clarified message channel.
A protective covering around the heart supplies an inward layer of blocked reception.
Auditory heaviness supplies a sensory layer that prevents uptake.
A preventing partition makes separation from the messenger an engineered relation.
Hearing as comprehension and compliance clarifies what the explicit refusal targets.
Mixed clamor supplies active acoustic interference meant to overpower the recitation.
Inner blindness names the terminal cognitive state produced by failed reception.
Distance turns an available call into one experienced as inaccessible.

structural_cues: 41:3 presents the signs as differentiated and intelligible.
41:4-5 answer that clarity with turning away, non-hearing, coverings, heaviness, and a barrier.
41:26 converts non-hearing into a deliberate noise tactic.
41:44 restages the result as ear-weight, blindness, and a call from far away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each reception barrier and their recurrence around explicit signs; I infer a cumulative causal architecture in which ilhad bends the channel of reception. A live alternative is that these are parallel descriptions of rejection rather than stages of one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Ilhad means holding or voicing a deviant interpretation of signs.
changed_reading.after: Ilhad becomes the active manufacture of non-reception: a clear marker is diverted by shielding the interior, burdening the senses, adding noise, and converting nearness into experienced distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: 41:34-35 describes redirecting evil with what is better and twice says that this is only made available to particular recipients. The repeated passive l-q-y then makes the focus casting echo an allocation contrast: one may be made to receive the difficult better response, or be cast into fire, while secure arrival stands on the other side.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses forced casting to present the punitive allocation as something done to its recipient.
Beneficial good anchors the comparative question to the nearby command to answer with what is better.
Settled safety marks the opposed outcome of the allocation.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies both the quality of the response and the comparative 'better' that transforms the relation.
Pushing harm aside supplies an active redirection rather than passive retaliation.
What a person is made to encounter of good or difficulty supplies the lexical bridge between ethical reception and final fate.
Self-restraint identifies the disposition able to receive and sustain the counter-response.
An allotted share makes reception sound like a granted portion rather than mere comprehension.

structural_cues: 41:34 commands a redirection of evil capable of converting an enemy into an intimate ally.
41:35 repeats the passive l-q-y form around patience and a great allotted share.
41:40 reuses passive l-q-y for casting while contrasting it with secure arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the local passive-root repetition, the better response, and the allotted share; I infer an allocative parallel between receiving a transformative ethic and receiving a punitive fate. The materially live alternative is a stylistic root recurrence with no causal bridge between 41:35 and 41:40.

changed_reading.before: The fire/security contrast is only a future sorting of already fixed classes.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also echoes present receptivity: the capacity to receive and enact the difficult better response stands against being passively allocated to fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise in 41:30-32 gives security a social and spatial texture: straight continuation, descending messengers, removal of anticipated harm, allied accompaniment, and prepared hospitality. The one who comes secure in the focus thus completes an already accompanied trajectory rather than merely escaping punishment.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the endpoint of a trajectory that the preceding promise begins before resurrection.
Inner settledness under freedom from harm names the focus outcome clarified by the earlier reassurance.
The final rising fixes the public endpoint at which accompanied security is displayed.
Straightness and maintained balance supply the lived trajectory leading toward secure arrival.
The descent of messengers supplies accompaniment that meets the steadfast before the final endpoint.
Expected future harm is explicitly removed, specifying the prospective content of security.
Loving alliance and support make security relational rather than merely juridical.
Prepared reception for an arriving guest gives the secure destination a hospitality structure.

structural_cues: 41:30 joins steadfastness to a descent that removes fear and grief.
41:31 extends allied support across present and future life.
41:32 names the promised destination as prepared reception for a guest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reassurance, continuity of alliance, and hospitality; I infer that these specify the texture and pathway of aminan in 41:40. A live alternative is that 41:30-32 is a parallel promise without defining the later term.

changed_reading.before: Coming secure means arriving exempt from the fire.
changed_reading.after: Coming secure is the completion of a straight, accompanied passage into prepared hospitality, with fear already displaced by an enduring alliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The material sign in revived earth, the outward signs in the horizons, the inward signs in selves, and the final encompassing closure leave no exterior side to which ilhad can escape. The focus denial of hiddenness becomes spatial as well as epistemic.

activation_trace.role: Inclining toward a supposed refuge supplies the attempted escape route.
Movement to an edge supplies the geometry tested by the surah's inside-out sign field.
Visible markers anchor the field in phenomena that disclose rather than conceal.
The same marker branch identifies the immediately preceding earth scene as part of the sign field.
The earth's life-bearing movement makes the sign materially enacted, not only verbally stated.
Far outward regions extend the sign field to the limits of viewed space.
The person's own self supplies the corresponding inward location of disclosure.
Emergence into clarity names what the outside-and-inside display is moving toward.
Complete cognitive enclosure closes the geometry by denying an unobserved outside.

structural_cues: 41:39 places an enacted sign in the revived earth immediately before the focus.
41:53 distributes signs across the horizons and the observers' own selves until truth becomes clear.
41:54 ends with comprehensive enclosure after naming doubt about meeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward, inward, material, and encompassing locations; I infer a closed sign topology in which lateral refuge is impossible. A live alternative is that the spatial terms accumulate rhetorically without forming a deliberate enclosure model.

changed_reading.before: Those who deviate within particular signs cannot hide their conduct from God.
changed_reading.after: They try to move toward an edge inside a sign field that spans earth, horizons, and self and is itself encompassed; hiddenness fails because there is no exterior position.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation shifts from the visibility of those attacking signs to the resilience of the reminder and book: falsehood cannot reach it from either direction. Ilhad therefore changes the condition of the actor and audience, not the integrity of the sign-bearing text; the failed attack exposes its agent.

activation_trace.role: Adversarial verbal turning anchors the attempted attack on communicated signs.
Removal of hiddenness makes the actor, rather than a damaged text, what is brought into disclosure.
Blocking or veiling truth locates the failure in reception of the reminder.
Ordered written discourse identifies the sign-bearing object that remains intact.
Resistance to being reached supplies the book's protected inaccessibility to corruption.
The denied act of arrival frames falsehood as unable to reach the text from any route.
Loss of truth or stability names the corrupting content whose entry is excluded.
Tight construction and reliability explain why the communicated object withstands the attempted approach.

structural_cues: 41:40 says the agents of ilhad are not hidden.
41:41 immediately names rejection of the reminder while describing the book as inaccessible to defeat.
41:42 denies falsehood any approach from before or behind and grounds the book in wise construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actor-visibility followed by textual resilience; I infer a reversal in which distortion reveals the distorter without penetrating the book. A live alternative is that the two claims are adjacent assurances rather than one failed-attack mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The warning says distortion is detected and punished.
changed_reading.after: It also separates effect from intention: distortion can obstruct a hearer, but it cannot enter and destabilize the text; instead, the attempt renders its agent visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the light branch of the fire root and could wrongly collapse fire into illumination. It remains anchored because fire stands between denied hiddenness and divine sight, while the surah places fire beside witnessing and earlier luminous lamps. Downstream prose should present it only as a root-family and compositional echo of exposure, not as the lexical meaning of al-nar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-nar occurs inside a sentence framed by la yakhfawna and basir.

activation_trace.role: Actual burning fire preserves the literal punitive destination of the focus contrast.
The root-family's luminous branch adds an exploratory exposure echo without replacing the fire sense.
Visual apprehension makes exposure a live compositional function around the fire.
Lamps establish controlled luminosity as a displayed feature of the ordered heavens.
The earlier fire destination begins the public gathering sequence that leads into testimony.
Present witnessing turns that destination sequence into an evidentiary scene.

changed_reading.before: Fire functions only as the punitive destination in the comparison.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, being cast into fire also completes the collapse of concealment: punishment occurs in a compositional field of exposure, sight, and testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grave-side and refuge branches are materially distant from ordinary ilhad in signs. It remains anchored to the focus root and gains a coherent spatial contrast from casting, permanent fire-lodging, and prepared hospitality elsewhere in the surah. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy, never a replacement gloss or a claim that the ayah literally describes burial architecture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The side-cut and refuge branches of l-h-d meet the focus contrast between being cast away and arriving secure.

activation_trace.role: A chamber cut into a side supplies the exploratory image of making concealment inside an already bounded structure.
Inclining toward shelter gives that side movement the attempted function of refuge.
A cast-off object supplies the opposed loss of protected placement.
A fixed lodging gives the fire a grim dwelling structure rather than a momentary contact.
Prepared guest-reception supplies the counter-space for the secure arriver.

changed_reading.before: Ilhad is an abstract deviation followed by one of two outcomes.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the deviator cuts toward a false side-refuge but ends as a cast-off in punitive lodging, while secure arrival is met by genuine hospitality.

strongest_changes: The work imperative returns the opponents' own 41:5 challenge after the surah has made deeds bodily self-disclosing and reflexive.
Ilhad becomes a cumulative practice of engineered non-reception rather than only an incorrect proposition about signs.
The passive l-q-y recurrence in 41:35 and 41:40 opens an allocative contrast between receiving the difficult better response and being cast into fire.
Signs distributed through revived earth, horizons, and selves, then closed by encompassing knowledge, turn failed hiddenness into a no-exterior spatial model.
The immediate 41:41-42 continuation distinguishes obstruction of hearers from any successful penetration of the resilient book.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed long-range recurrences of work, covering, hearing, testimony, passive l-q-y, hospitality, and inside-outside geometry that a focus-only reading leaves disconnected.
remaining_uncertainties: The ethical-allocation link through l-q-y may be deliberate local architecture or only conspicuous verbal recurrence.
The 41:30-32 promise strongly textures aminan, but it may remain a parallel promise rather than a direct specification.
The closed sign field and fire-as-exposure models depend on compositional inference beyond ordinary lexical force.
The grave-side/refuge model is useful only as a carefully contained material analogy.
